content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

left = pd.DataFrame({"time": [2, 5], "event": ["a", "b"]})
right = pd.DataFrame({"time": [1, 4], "state": ["x", "y"]})
print(pd.merge_asof(left, right, on="time")["state"].tolist())
